title: Swiipt Research / Evidence Gap
description: Canonical persisted representation of an unresolved research/evidence need (research-to-transformation pipeline V1, Phases F/G/H). Deliberately SEPARATE from the MAE campaign-inventory GapRequest: campaign gaps are non-blocking marketing-inventory shortages, research gaps carry provenance/applicability/blocking semantics for the research pipeline. A gap is never resolved without the evidence its resolution criteria require.

source_ref.description: The research source/record the gap relates to, when known.

required_evidence.description: Machine-readable statement of what evidence/information would resolve the gap.

blocks_progression.description: Whether an OPEN gap blocks its blocking_stage. A gap must block only the stage it genuinely affects.

resolution_source.description: Where the resolving evidence came from (a governed resolver: human, approved agent, provider, document).

requires_evidence.description: When true, a resolution must cite evidence; status=RESOLVED with no evidence is refused.

evaluator.description: Name of the deterministic re-evaluation applied to close the gap.
